lyrics:
[Intro: bouncy funk guitar, bubbly synth bass, a can opening]

[Verse 1: deadpan, breathy, light beat]
Oh, he's rearranged his week
Learned my coffee, learned my street
Told his mother, told his priest
I said hi, at least

[Pre-Chorus: claps, voice sweetens]
I can't relate to wanting more
I'm what the wanting's for

[Chorus: full disco-funk groove, stacked harmonies]
I'm a main character energy drink
One sip and he forgets how to think
Zero sugar, a hundred per cent
Side effects include commitment
Is it me? It's me, it's the fizz
Limited edition, and it is what it is

[Verse 2: deadpan, quicker]
I can't talk, I've got a thing (it's a nap)
He sent flowers, sent a ring (sent it back)
Said I'm cruel, I said I'm booked
He said "please," I said "look"

[Pre-Chorus: claps, voice sweetens]
I can't relate to wanting more
I'm what the wanting's for

[Chorus: full disco-funk groove, stacked harmonies]
I'm a main character energy drink
One sip and he forgets how to think
Zero sugar, a hundred per cent
Side effects include commitment
Is it me? It's me, it's the fizz
Limited edition, and it is what it is

[Bridge: beat thins, spoken-sung like a label being read]
Shake well
Serve cold
Do not operate heavy machinery
Keep out of reach of exes

[Final Chorus: everything, ad-libs, extra guitar]
I'm a main character energy drink
One sip and he forgets how to think
Zero sugar, a hundred per cent
Side effects include commitment
Is it me? It's me, it's the fizz
Limited edition, and it is what it is

[Outro: guitar lick, a sip, a satisfied sigh]
Mm. That's me.
